investigations.name: og-00-vent-reactor-baseline
investigations.title: The Serpentinizing Vent
investigations.objective: Can a Lost City-like, serpentinization-fed vent-ocean interface reproduce the physical and chemical environment in which the later origin-of-life steps are supposed to occur?
investigations.claim: Across the swept olivine-rate x flow-velocity grid, about 80% of the operating region falls inside the combined Lost City window (40-91 C, pH 9.0-10.8, positive H2 flux), and the baseline settles comfortably inside it at 50.6 C / pH 9.37 with sustained H2, exact charge balance, and spatial-flux divergence within tolerance. This establishes a bounded geochemical habitat, a region rather than a single tuned point, and makes no origin-of-life claim by itself.

investigations.name: og-00b-ph-endmember-sweep
investigations.title: Bounding the pH endmember — pyroxene fraction and seawater-mixing dilution
investigations.objective: How far does the og-00 habitability window move when the host-rock pyroxene fraction and the seawater-mixing dilution are varied, and does the habitable region survive at the acidic, dilute endmember the recent reassessment emphasises?
baseline_names: Vent reactor at the olivine endmember (og-00 canonical)

investigations.name: og-01-cal-dx-label-disagreement
investigations.title: Why do the empirical and Butler-Volmer classes disagree on the limitation label?
investigations.objective: Is the empirical-vs-Butler-Volmer disagreement on the dominant limitation label (they agree on only 47% of the region both call favorable) a real structural difference in how each class represents electrical, catalytic, and transport limits, or an avoidable artifact of binning and threshold placement?
baseline_names: Electrochemical interface — both classes, og-01-cal canonical grid

investigations.name: og-01-cal-electrochemistry
investigations.title: The Vent Wall as a Galvanic Cell: Which Limitation Stops Carbon Fixation, and Do the Model Classes Agree?
investigations.objective: Treating the vent wall as an explicit galvanic cell (Nernst potentials, Butler-Volmer kinetics), do the empirical and the electrochemical model classes agree on which limitation (thermodynamic, electrical, catalytic, transport) stops carbon fixation across the region both call favorable - the pre-registered test being at least 80% agreement on the limitation label?
investigations.claim: No. The two classes agree on the dominant-limitation label on only 47% of the favorable region, below the pre-registered 80% gate, so the gate fails and the attribution is structure-sensitive. Under explicit electrochemistry the vent cell is activation (catalyst) limited everywhere the wall conducts and electrical only below ~1e-6 S/m, but the empirical rate law's single Michaelis drive term lumps electrical and catalytic limitation together and invents a transport limit the cell physics never reaches. The electrochemistry itself is real, calibrated to the Altair-2025 current window, and ledger-exact on all 750 runs; what the study cannot yet deliver is a structure-independent answer to why fixation stops, recorded as an open decision for the expert rather than dressed up as a result.

investigations.name: og-01-geology-to-reduced-carbon
investigations.title: The First Carbon
investigations.objective: Can geological H2 drive CO2 reduction on vent mineral catalysts strongly enough to sustain a source of reduced organic carbon?
investigations.claim: Over Fe/Ni/S catalysts the model reproduces the Preiner-2020 yield hierarchy - formate about 200 mM, acetate about 100 uM, pyruvate about 10 uM - and sustains net organic-carbon flux inside a bounded region set by the pH gradient and dissolved H2, while the no-gradient, no-H2 and no-catalyst controls collapse it. A discriminating in-situ arm (Tutolo-2026) shows the usable proton-motive gradient falling from 427 to 43 mV, roughly halving the sustained flux. Because the CO2-reduction kinetics are lab-calibrated to Preiner rather than derived from first-principles surface chemistry, this establishes a computational bridge from serpentinization to an organic-carbon feedstock, not yet metabolism.

investigations.name: og-04-alt-endogenous-boundary
investigations.title: The Endogenous Boundary
investigations.objective: Can a protocell boundary form from the campaign's own reduced-carbon chemistry - an amphiphile synthesized from acetate + formate that clears the critical aggregation concentration - rather than from an injected amphiphile pool, and is its formation caused by that synthesis?
investigations.claim: Vent-fed chemistry, through explicit chain-extension, headgroup and degradation reactions across multiple amphiphile species, either reaches an experimentally-grounded aggregation-competent composition on its own — assembling via the real og-31 / viva-openmm membrane closure — or it does not, in which case boundary formation is not supported by defensible endogenous kinetics. The single assumed acetate+formate→amphiphile condensation is retired in favour of named reactions with tracked rates and losses.
baseline_names: Endogenous amphiphiles by explicit chain extension

investigations.name: og-04-mineral-compartments-to-protocells
investigations.title: The First Boundary
investigations.objective: Do mixed-amphiphile membranes improve retention while staying permeable enough to keep access to the vent-supplied gradient and feedstocks?
investigations.claim: In a bounded alkaline / seawater-salt window mixed single-chain amphiphiles form viable vesicles (about 8000) where single fatty acids form none, and those compartments retain internal chemistry (retention 0.91) while staying permeable to the external gradient (access 1.0), a retention-without-isolation product near 0.90, with the feasibility map marking a viable region at 63/256 points (about 25%). This provides a plausible transition from mineral localization to an organic boundary. The membrane model is coarse-grained and calibrated to the Jordan-2019 vesicle experiments rather than membrane MD, and whether enclosing a reaction network actually improves its persistence over the open pore is left to downstream studies.

investigations.name: og-07-alt-real-metabolite-exchange
investigations.title: Biochemical Ecology: A Community Function That No Lineage Can Perform, Carried by Real Metabolite Flux
investigations.objective: If every protocell carries the same real rule-generated chemistry masked to its own catalyst repertoire, can a community of incomplete lineages realise a metabolic function no lineage performs alone, sustained by a real intermediate crossing membranes rather than a symbolic capability transfer?
investigations.claim: A community of one carboxylating and one hydrogenating lineage holds malate - the reductive C4 branch from oxaloacetate - at 6.4 nM while neither monoculture ever makes it and a complete cell makes it at about 20x the level. The function vanishes when nothing is shared, and its oxaloacetate precursor physically crosses between the lineages, so no capability changes hands; it appears while every cell is still incomplete. It exists only above a dicarboxylate membrane permeability of ~3e-9 m/s, one to two decades above the measured passage of charged solutes through fatty-acid vesicles, so the leakiness of the boundary rather than the chemistry decides whether ecology could run on exchanged intermediates - and at ~4e-3 molecules per cell the result is a mean-field expectation that still awaits a stochastic treatment.
baseline_names: Metabolite-exchange community — fixer + reducer lineages at the canonical point

investigations.name: og-07-ecology-before-luca
investigations.title: Ecology Before LUCA
investigations.objective: Can a connected population of heterogeneous protocells develop capabilities - functional redundancy and robustness - that no single already-complete ancestral compartment holds on its own?
investigations.claim: A connected metacommunity of eight heterogeneous pore compartments develops functional redundancy that an isolated compartment cannot, reaching robustness about 0.71 against the isolated counterfactual's 0.42 and beating it on every one of eight seeds, so most functions get at least two-fold coverage and survive loss of a compartment. This emerges only in a bounded corner of the phase map: enough inter-compartment diversity to give cross-feeding something to share, enough exchange to spread it, and low enough parasite load not to erase it. The collective repertoire's roughly 0.6-0.7 overlap with an anaerobic H2/CO2/FeS LUCA reconstruction is reported as a far-end boundary the emergent set approaches, not as evidence that the earliest compartments were already LUCA-like.

investigations.name: og-27-coupled-geochemical-reaction-interface
investigations.title: Coupled Geochemical Reaction Interface
investigations.objective: Can an evolving mineral–water interface sustainably supply carbon, H2, chemical gradients and catalysis to a prebiotic reaction network — and over what timescale, before mineral evolution (precipitation, passivation) chokes that supply?
investigations.claim: An evolving mineral–water interface at a Lost City–type vent can be modeled as a coupled geochemical reactor whose precipitation, dissolution and surface passivation reshape — not merely sustain — its delivery of H2, inorganic carbon, pH/redox gradients and catalytic surface. Whether that delivery stays above the level a downstream reaction network needs, and for how long before mineral evolution throttles it, is the quantity this study measures; sustained reactive flux is a result to demonstrate, not an assumption.

investigations.name: og-31-protometabolism-to-amphiphiles
investigations.title: Protometabolism to Amphiphiles
investigations.objective: Can actual metabolic products — not supplied amphiphiles — yield membrane-forming amphiphile mixtures under vent-local conditions?
investigations.claim: Under a reduced-coupling membrane model - retention reduces effective washout, finite access reduces effective feed crossing, explicitly NOT the MD-resolved permeability PMF (that is study 32's full Gate C test) - an endogenous membrane pays for itself on persistence but not on throughput. On the Gate-B pore-concentrated network, which is the sustained A1 carbon-fixing metabolism and NOT autocatalytic (A2 is refuted under vent conditions), a membrane at the Jordan-2019 vent-calibrated setting (retention 0.905, access 0.997; grounded, not tuned) raises the standing metabolite pool to about 2.9x the no-membrane ablation, while net carbon-fixation flux is about 0.6x - lower, because throughput is feed-limited, so reduced washout grows the pool rather than the rate. The benefit is windowed: it holds for membrane access down to about 0.45 and inverts below that (a too-tight membrane starves the feed and the retained pool falls below the open system), with the vent-calibrated access inside the window. This is the "benefits from it" half of Gate C, complementing og-31's Martini-MD cohesion (the "makes a membrane" half); the structurally-resolved coupling is study 32.

investigations.name: og-32-first-self-maintaining-protocell
investigations.title: First Self-Maintaining Protocell
investigations.objective: Can a vent-fed metabolism and an endogenous membrane be coupled so the membrane encloses and is maintained by the metabolism - and does the enclosed system persist and function better than the same metabolism with no membrane, at equal feeds?
investigations.claim: A composite coupling the endogenous vent-fed metabolism to an endogenous membrane - with the membrane's permeability informed by short molecular dynamics of its amphiphile composition, a tighter coupling than og-31's retention/access proxy - self-maintains in the measurable sense: at input fluxes held equal to a no-endogenous-membrane ablation, the membrane is rebuilt by metabolism-supplied amphiphiles at least as fast as it degrades (net production >= degradation) AND the enclosed system exceeds the ablation on persistence (standing metabolite pool ~2.0x). Throughput is not improved (0.79x, feed-limited) - so the benefit is retention, not faster chemistry, and the verdict is qualified, not an unconditional pass. The metabolism is the sustained A1 carbon-fixing network (not autocatalytic; A2 refuted), so the result is that a persisting network can make and keep a membrane that pays its way on persistence, within a located window (integrity holds up to a degradation rate k_deg <= ~0.01/s, and the persistence benefit tracks the MD composition).

investigations.name: og-32b-fatty-acid-vesicle-stability
investigations.title: Fatty-Acid Vesicle Stability
investigations.objective: Do real single-chain fatty-acid amphiphiles self-assemble into and hold a STABLE closed bilayer vesicle (the protocell boundary) under vent conditions, across what chain-length window (C10-C16), and does the matched null - the same amphiphile with fully-ionised, charged-only heads - fail by micellising, as fatty-acid vesicle physics predicts?
investigations.claim: Real single-chain fatty-acid vesicles hold a closed bilayer shell across the C10-C16 chain-length axis on a short-MD stability trend, while the matched fully-charged null destabilises toward a micelle at the short-chain corner - a real-amphiphile boundary, replacing og-32's phospholipid stand-in (verdict qualified; the converged chain-length/charge window is the GPU gold-standard follow-up).
baseline_names: Gate-C protocell boundary informed by the real fatty-acid vesicle MD

investigations.name: og-33-chemically-coupled-growth-and-division
investigations.title: Chemically Coupled Growth and Division
investigations.objective: Can a self-maintaining protocell grow and divide as a consequence of its own chemistry - membrane area and content increasing from metabolism until a physical instability splits it - rather than by an imposed division rule, and are the daughters viable?
investigations.claim: The protocell grows from its own metabolic amphiphile production and divides at a physically-grounded, measured area-doubling geometry - yielding viable daughters that resume self-maintenance - rather than by an imposed rule. Division rate scales with metabolic flux (coupled) while a growth-decoupled null is flux-independent and an imposed-division null divides on a timer; the metabolism-coupled arm beats both matched nulls at equal feeds, and daughters are viable only because they resume the study-32 self-maintenance criterion (integrity plus benefit over the no-membrane ablation). The verdict is qualified: the criterion is met on the measured-geometry first cut (Option B); full coarse-grained membrane mechanics (Option A, og-33a) is the budgeted follow-up. The metabolism is the sustained A1 carbon-fixing network (not autocatalytic), so growth is funded by carbon fixation, not self-amplification.
baseline_names: Chemically coupled growth and division (metabolism-coupled, measured geometry)

investigations.name: og-36-stochastic-protocell-ecology
investigations.title: Stochastic Protocell Ecology
investigations.objective: In a heterogeneous protocell population under honest stochastic low-count dynamics, do cross-feeding and community-level function develop that single lineages do not have at equal feed - and do stochastic dynamics materially change the outcome versus the deterministic mean-field?
investigations.claim: A stochastic cross-feeding protocell community out-produces the best single lineage at equal feed - a real, cross-feeding-caused community function - but that benefit is productivity, not robustness. At the shared feed budget held equal to a matched best-single-lineage control, a ring of 4 cross-feeding lineages does ~1.9x the best single lineage's cumulative productivity (margin positive in every seed), and knocking out cross-feeding (same feed) collapses the margin to ~2% - so the benefit is causally cross-feeding, not mere diversity, with coexistence stabilised by depletable byproduct pools (negative frequency dependence), not assumed. BUT under low-count demographic noise the community is ~2x more variable than the rock-stable monoculture and loses a lineage in ~12% of runs; a system-size sweep shows this divergence from the deterministic mean-field GROWING as counts fall (to ~31% extinction / 20% margin erosion at half scale). So the honest result is the counterpoint to the required spine: cross-feeding genuinely RAISES productivity (the campaign's first throughput win) but PAYS in robustness - verdict qualified - and the GillesPy2/COBRApy genome-scale resolution (og-36a) is the follow-up. The metabolism is the sustained A1 cross-feeding community, not autocatalytic (A2 refuted).
baseline_names: Cross-feeding knockout (community, cross-feeding off, equal feed)

investigations.name: og-adv-generic-nonequilibrium
investigations.title: The Adversarial Control
investigations.objective: Are the campaign's positive gates genuinely dependent on vent-specific mechanisms, or would any generic driven nonequilibrium chemistry pass them? It should not.
investigations.claim: Run with the vent's characteristic features ablated - no sustained H2, no Fe/Ni/S catalytic interface and no pore concentration - the same real composites fail all five discriminating gates (carbon flux, formate yield, protometabolic throughput, thermophoretic Peclet and enrichment), while the vent configuration passes all five, with the tightest rejection margin about 1.8 decades. This is a falsification control: a pass elsewhere in the campaign certifies the vent mechanism rather than simply any nonequilibrium chemistry producing activity. The extreme enrichment magnitude itself is a reduced-model, solver-sensitive figure and is used only as a pass/fail discriminator here.
baseline_names: Generic non-vent control (carbon-fixation composite, vent features off)

investigations.name: og-autocatalysis-a2
investigations.title: Endogenous Autocatalysis (A2): Formose and Reductive-TCA Routes
investigations.objective: Can vent-fed chemistry spontaneously form a balanced, self-amplifying autocatalytic cycle that beats a matched null with equal input fluxes — across the two representable routes (rule-generated linear-C6 formose chemistry, and the curated branched reductive-TCA cycle) — or does it only fix carbon (persistence, A1) without self-amplifying (A2)?
investigations.claim: Endogenous self-amplifying autocatalysis is refuted under vent conditions across both representable routes, each against its own matched null. The linear-C6 formose arm (og-29) is thermodynamically refuted and seed-independent: the canonical doubling step (r409, 2 glycolaldehyde <-> threose) runs toward condensation (dG0 -16.4 kJ/mol) at vent feeds, so the splitting direction carries no net flux (gain 0, motifs 0 across x1-x50) and production is feed-driven, not self-amplified. The branched reductive-TCA arm (og-rtca) is autocatalytic in TOPOLOGY (its net turn doubles oxaloacetate with no coefficient-2 reaction, so a coefficient detector reads 0 by construction and a coefficient-free functional discriminator is required), yet washes out under vent H2 because the closing reductive carboxylations (succinate->a-ketoglutarate +18, acetyl->pyruvate +31 kJ/mol) run uphill and too slow against washout — the same reason the biological cycle uses ferredoxin, not H2. In a LABELLED beyond-vent counterfactual (lower carboxylation barrier + lower dilution) the same rTCA topology meets the self-amplification bar and is topology-specific (the matched null stays off), so the vent negative is a redox-environment limitation, not a defect of the cycle's wiring. The counterfactual is explicitly not a vent claim. Headline verdict is bounded by the honest negative of both arms: refuted. Every matched null and every arm verdict is preserved explicitly.
baseline_names: Endogenous autocatalysis — formose keystone arm (og-29, canonical)
Reductive-TCA degree-preserving matched null (equal feeds) — og-rtca matched null

investigations.name: og-cal-vent-environment
investigations.title: Calibrating the Vent: What Fraction of Observed-Consistent Vent States Feed Downstream Chemistry
investigations.objective: Of the real-vent states consistent with the Lost City field observations (outlet temperature, pH, dissolved H2), what fraction also satisfies what downstream carbon fixation needs (H2 >= 1 mM, a >= 3-unit pH gradient, T in range), and which observation does the actual constraining?
investigations.claim: Conditioning the real PHREEQC + FiPy vent on the Lost City field windows, 12.5% of the empirically motivated prior (6 of 48 draws) reproduces all three observations, and 100% of that posterior supplies the H2 and pH gradient downstream carbon fixation requires. The dissolved-H2 window does all the constraining: pH is buffered at 9.4-9.9 by the peridotite assemblage and carries no information, temperature is loose, and the answer is the same whether or not the vent wall convects. The conservation ledger closes exactly on all 96 runs. This is a geochemical calibration, not an origin-of-life claim, and the H2 threshold rests on a full-redox-equilibrium assumption and an extrapolated DIC prior that a kinetic carbon-redox class could still shift.

investigations.name: og-energetics
investigations.title: Proto-Energetics: Capture, Internalization, and Carrier Coupling
investigations.objective: Can a primitive chemical system capture geochemical free energy, internalize it under selection, and couple a specified carrier to perform endergonic work — and does any of it improve total throughput, or only persistence/robustness — each tested against a matched null with a closing ledger?
investigations.claim: Across fidelities, a protocell's energetics buy robustness/persistence, not raw throughput. A primitive carrier captures geochemical free energy into a transferable store with a closing ledger (proto-energetics arm, supported); a compartment internalizes electrochemical work under selection and pays for it within a Sojo-bounded survival region (internalization arm, supported); which coupling chemistry pays is structure-sensitive and membrane-leak-dependent (5-class alt arm, supported, classes agree ~46%); and a specified thioester carrier does useful work through a gradient dip where gradient-only starves but does NOT improve total useful work (sharpened Gate-E arm, og-35, qualified). The consolidated headline is bounded by that sharpest arm: qualified, dip-persistence not throughput. Every matched null and every arm verdict is preserved explicitly.
baseline_names: Chemical energy coupling (thioester carrier) — canonical headline arm (og-35)
Gradient-only null (no carrier store, equal drive/load) — og-35 matched null

investigations.name: og-growth-alt-physical-reproduction
investigations.title: Physical Reproduction
investigations.objective: Can an individual physically reproduce - grow to a division threshold and divide into daughters that grow and divide in turn - building a multi-generation lineage with matter and volume conserved at every division?
investigations.claim: A founder individual grows to threshold and divides by a structural rewrite that halves its matter and volume, its daughters do the same, and the lineage reaches 5 generations in the agents map, past the 3-generation bar, with the partition residual exactly 0 at every division. Matter and volume are conserved throughout. What the model demonstrates is the conserving division-and-lineage mechanism; growth itself is abstracted to a division trigger rather than the full osmotic volume growth, which coupling the two would supply.
baseline_names: Founder lineage — growth to a >=3-generation lineage

investigations.name: og-growth-division
investigations.title: Growth and Division
investigations.objective: Can an internal autocatalytic metabolism change a compartment's physical fate - driving growth and division through osmotic pressure alone - without assigning any abstract fitness score?
investigations.claim: An internal autocatalytic source accumulates an osmolyte whose osmotic pressure draws solvent across the membrane and grows the compartment to a division threshold; in the matched regime it divides eight times over the run, with an osmolyte mass-balance residual of about 4e-32 mol. Only about 25% of the throughput by permeability grid forms a viable growth-to-division band, flanked by starvation when the membrane is too permeable and the product leaks before pressure can build, and lysis when it is too impermeable and the pressure bursts the membrane, while zero throughput produces essentially no growth. The model therefore delivers a chemically selected, dividing protocell through mass-conserving osmotic coupling, with no abstract fitness function assigned.
baseline_names: Metabolism to osmotic growth and division (favorable)

investigations.name: og-heredity
investigations.title: Chemical Heredity and Selection
investigations.objective: Does the protocell transmit an inherited chemical difference that carries selectable information at a feasible cost and produces a reproducible fitness difference against a no-inheritance control — and at what fidelity (compositional vs template)?
investigations.claim: Across fidelities, an inherited chemical difference in the protocell is transmitted and selectable. Competing modules show heredity need not presume a long RNA template and that compositional / hybrid inheritance escapes the Eigen length catastrophe (og-06, supported); the information-per-cost frontier resolves which mechanisms transmit heritable bits per joule, attachment conditional on budget (og-06-alt, supported); and a daughter-inherited compositional difference produces a reproducible, selectable fitness difference — parent-offspring correlation +0.949 vs a no-inheritance control, with the population shifting under selection (og-34, qualified, canonical). Consolidated headline: qualified, compositional inheritance; template copying is the og-34a follow-up. Every matched null and arm verdict kept.
baseline_names: Chemical heredity & selection — inheritance arm (canonical, og-34)

investigations.name: og-independence
investigations.title: Escape and Progressive Independence from the Vent
investigations.objective: How independent of its geological cradle can a vent-born protocell lineage become — what minimum innovation set lets it persist as external support is withdrawn, which supports can it internalize vs which remain hard dependencies, and is any apparent independence causally attributable to a specific innovation against a matched ablation with input fluxes held equal?
investigations.claim: A vent-born protocell lineage reaches GRADED, attributed independence, not an all-or-nothing (and not a free) escape. og-08 withdrew gradient + mineral + feed JOINTLY and found a coordinated innovation set {internal pump, importer, heredity} where any single removal collapses persistence — but joint relaxation cannot attribute which innovation rescues which support, so that general minimal-sufficiency reading is rescoped to a reduced, model-specific hypothesis (supported within its one coarse model). og-08-alt-robust then tests the minimum-sufficient set ACROSS model structures and returns an honest negative: no subset is jointly sufficient at the nominal ocean floor; driver-specifically, pump + heredity are where anything persists and the active importer is a net cost under a leaky membrane. og-37 resolves the attribution by withdrawing each support ONE AT A TIME with a matched per-support ablation: each channel is internalizable with the full set and causally attributed (gradient<-pump, mineral<-importer, feed<-importer), heredity is the irreducible substrate, and the gradient channel is budget-sensitive (internalization flips to a hard dependency below pump efficiency ~0.7, grounded in the energy arm's persistence-not-throughput surplus). Because the feed is LUMPED (H2+CO2+organics) and the innovations are coarse budget abstractions, this is an affordability/attribution profile, not a demonstrated escape — headline verdict qualified. Every matched null and every arm verdict is preserved explicitly.
baseline_names: Progressive independence (all-at-once, full innovation set) — canonical headline arm (og-37)
One-at-a-time per-channel withdrawal (the attribution novelty) — og-37
Escape from the vent (joint all-at-once relaxation) — og-08 foundation arm
Integrated autonomy — minimum-sufficient set across structures (honest negative) — og-08-alt-robust

investigations.name: og-network-persistence
investigations.title: Network Persistence: Does the Carbon-Fixing Network Sustain Itself?
investigations.objective: Under continuous vent-realistic feed and washout, does the prebiotic carbon-fixing network persist and sustain net carbon throughput as a connected system — and does it do so by endogenous autocatalytic amplification or merely by sustained driven flux — each arm tested against a matched null with a closing ledger?
investigations.claim: Across fidelities the prebiotic carbon-fixing network persists — it sustains net carbon throughput as a connected system under vent-realistic feed + washout (og-02, canonical, supported) — but its persistence is driven, not autocatalytic self-amplification. Graded by a common detector, og-02's curated rTCA motif is imposed and element-unbalanced (the apparent gain an artifact); the rule-generated open universe (121 species, 413 balanced reactions) sustains a 14-species persistent network with NO autocatalytic motif at the vent feed, because every C-C-forming route is uphill, and the single motif that emerges (formose) requires an exogenous formaldehyde feed the vent chemistry does not make (og-02-alt, supported, p=0.04 vs 24 matched nulls). A versioned, provenance-tracked reaction atlas with a zero-leakage write gate supplies the balanced, confidence-tiered reactions both arms draw on (og-28, supported). Consolidated headline: supported — the network persists; endogenous autocatalysis is refuted at vent feed and tracked as the og-autocatalysis line. Every matched null and arm verdict kept.
baseline_names: No-CO2-feed matched null (og-02) — network collapses without the carbon source
Rule-generated open chemical universe at the vent posterior (og-02-alt arm)

investigations.name: og-res-nitrogen-assimilation
investigations.title: The Nitrogen Bottleneck
investigations.objective: Can an FeS-mediated vent reduce the early ocean's oxidised and inert nitrogen (nitrate, nitrite, N2) to ammonium fast enough to keep pace with carbon fixation, or does nitrogen become the first limiting resource?
investigations.claim: In the favourable regime FeS-mediated reduction of nitrate through nitrite sustains a standing ammonium pool of about 1.0 mM and holds the C:N supply ratio near 5, inside the viable near-Redfield band, with nitrogen conserved to machine precision. Strip out the FeS catalyst or the H2 reductant and ammonium falls below a micromolar, while scarce nitrate pushes the C:N ratio to about 47. Nitrogen therefore keeps pace only within a bounded nitrate-supply by FeS-activity region, and outside it nitrogen - not carbon or energy - becomes the first limiting resource.
baseline_names: Nitrogen as a limiting resource — favourable

investigations.name: og-res-phosphorus-availability
investigations.title: The Phosphorus Bottleneck
investigations.objective: Can the same thermal-gradient vent pore that concentrates carbon and nitrogen also make phosphorus chemically available, or does phosphate precipitate and adsorb before it is useful?
investigations.claim: A P-speciation network coupled to the thermal pore makes reactive phosphorus net-positive only in a bounded phosphate-source by pore-enrichment window where condensation and activation outrun the precipitation and adsorption sink; at the favourable point reactive P accumulates to about 94% of the supplied phosphorus with only about 6% precipitated. The same enrichment that concentrates carbon co-concentrates phosphorus, whereas the open-pore ablation precipitates about 96% of it before it is useful. In the model phosphorus is thus a localization-gated bottleneck rather than a freely available input.

investigations.name: og-spatial-concentration
investigations.title: Spatial Concentration: Does a Pore Make an Individual?
investigations.objective: Can vent pore physics concentrate a dilute vent feed strongly enough to form a persistent localized individual and ignite the reaction network productively — more than a matched well-mixed, non-concentrating control at identical feeds?
investigations.claim: Across fidelities, vent pore physics concentrates a dilute feed into a persistent localized individual and ignites the reaction network. Resolving diffusion, thermophoresis, adsorption, surface catalysis and advection, a bounded serpentinite pore clears the Baaske-2007 extreme-accumulation regime (accumulation Peclet 18.4) and localizes a persistent individual vs a well-mixed control (og-03, supported). At identical vent-posterior feeds the concentrating pore ignites the full network — net carbon flux +4.5e-4, 17 persistent species — while a matched well-mixed, non-concentrating control stays dark (og-30, canonical, supported); the C6 network og-29 found needs ~20x well-mixed feed ignites directly in the pore at base feed. The pore benefit is a bounded porosity window, and network_connected is a brittle proxy near threshold (both kept honest). og-30 does double duty: it meets Gate B and resolves Gate A1's feed-plausibility.
